props.custom_logic_action:
const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][IP-DIFF-x10]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD");

return;

}

// Resolve attacker

const attackerActor =

(await context?.helpers?.getAttackerActor?.()) ??

((await fromUuid(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? ""))?.actor ??

(await fromUuid(p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? "")));

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.");

return;

}

// Resolve first target

const targetUuids = Array.isArray(p.targets) ? p.targets : [];

const firstTargetUuid = targetUuids[0] ?? null;

if (!firstTargetUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "No target found.");

return;

}

const targetDoc = await fromUuid(firstTargetUuid);

const targetActor = targetDoc?.actor ?? targetDoc;

if (!targetActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve target actor.");

return;

}

// Read IP values

const userIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(attackerActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

const targetIp = Math.max(

0,

parseInt(targetActor?.system?.props?.current_ip ?? "0", 10) || 0

);

// Only grant bonus if user IP is higher than target IP

const ipDifference = Math.max(0, userIp - targetIp);

const bonus = ipDifference * 10;

// Apply bonus

p.advPayload ??= {};

const bonusBefore = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = bonusBefore + bonus;

// Optional debug/meta

p.meta ??= {};

p.meta.ipDiffBonus = {

userIp,

targetIp,

ipDifference,

bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "APPLIED", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

target: targetActor?.name,

userIp,

targetIp,

ipDifference,

bonusBefore,

bonusAdded: bonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

context?.log?.("Applied IP difference bonus damage", {

attacker: attackerActor?.name,

target: targetActor?.name,

userIp,

targetIp,

ipDifference,

bonusBefore,

bonusAdded: bonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});
props.description: Deal Physical damage base on the 【Different between your IP and the target x 10】, When you reduce a target to 0 HP with this skill, Gain 2 IP
props.name: Bandit Raid
